scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,telegram-mcp -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @luma/server" "npm run dev -w @luma/web" "npm run dev -w @luma/telegram-mcp"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @luma/shared && npm run build -w @luma/server && npm run build -w @luma/web && npm run build -w @luma/telegram-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @luma/shared && npm run typecheck -w @luma/server && npm run typecheck -w @luma/web && npm run typecheck -w @luma/telegram-mcp
